why: Company press release dated 2026-11-13 (Shanghai, GlobeNewswire) says Q3 2026 unaudited results come out on Wed 2026-11-25 after the US close, with the call at 7:30 PM ET. The reaction lands in Friday 11-27's half-day session.
session_evidence: Release 'after the close of U.S. markets' on 2026-11-25, call 7:30 PM ET / 8:30 AM Beijing on 11-26: https://menafn.com/1111956605/Finvolution-Group-To-Report-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-On-Wednesday-November-25-2026 . This matches Q3 2025, which also had a 7:30 PM ET call: https://www.barchart.com/story/news/36063492/finvolution-group-to-report-third-quarter-2025-financial-results-on-wednesday-november-19-2025
where_to_look: Q3 guidance already pointed to a 'considerable contraction' in China volume, so the gap is between that warning and actual Q3 transaction volume. Look at PBOC/NFRA online-lending and loan-facilitation rule changes and at collection-industry crackdown news during Q3 and Q4. The Q2 call blamed both.

Funding-partner side: Q2 cited a tightening funding environment. Check bank and trust partner disclosures and peer prints already out this month (Qifu/QFIN, LexinFintech/LX, Jiayin/JFIN, Yiren) for funding cost and take-rate read-through. These are linked counterparties in the same funding channel.

International segment (Indonesia/Philippines), where Q2 overseas unique borrowers were up 130%: check OJK/Indonesia P2P regulatory data and app-download or review volume for its overseas apps (AdaKami, etc.).
Full-year revenue guide RMB11.5-12.9bn 'near the lower end': whether Q4 implies a cut, and whether the 2027 shareholder-return policy (buyback/dividend) is extended. Q2 buybacks were $27.4m.
already_in_the_wire: Q2 2026 (2026-08-27): transaction volume RMB41.0bn, -19.3% YoY; net profit RMB426.8m vs 751.3m; China unique borrowers -18.2%; FY revenue guide kept but 'near lower end'; warned Q3 China volume would contract considerably: https://www.financialcontent.com/article/gnwcq-2026-8-27-finvolution-group-reports-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results
Stock at a 52-week low into the print (run-up 20d -17.5%, -62% from 52w high, per the baseline tape)
Options imply about a 17% event move (baseline); a third-party preview cites an 11.8-14% implied move: https://unusualwhales.com/news/finvolution-earnings-preview-implied-move-2026-11-25
trades_on: The guide and outlook commentary. Q2 2026 fell sharply (baseline -15.4% on 2026-08-28) on 'lower end' revenue guidance and a warned Q3 China volume contraction, not on the reported quarter: https://www.ainvest.com/news/finvolution-market-heard-caution-sold-2608/ . Q1 2026 rose +10.2% (baseline 2026-05-26); the line that drove it is unknown.
